role: 氷の結晶 (head). A small ice jewel set on the red gem in the middle of the helmet's forehead; a four-point glint (drawn in code, src/ui/heroAccessories.ts) pops on its upper right every 2.6 s.

source.description: pixel art game item: a tiny pale blue ice crystal, a small sharp faceted ice shard pointing up, a little jewel ornament, dark outline, very small and simple

note: Hand-placed 7x9 (variant A: white facets on the upper left) in the colors of variation #0; the generated shards were too big for the forehead gem. The pivot lies outside the image: it is the head anchor (dome top), and the jewel sits 2 px right and 4 px below it, over the red gem (measured about +5, +7.5..8.2 from the anchor in every frame). Alpha is 0/255 only.
history: Started as 氷の冠 (a crown). Earlier tries: seed 8601 at 28x16 (thin ice tiaras) and seed 8602 at 24x24 (crystal clusters). The user found crowns did not suit the helmet, asked for a one-point item instead, renamed it 氷の結晶, then asked for it smaller and on the forehead's red gem, and for a stronger ice look with an occasional twinkle.
